description: Every active scenario in the report must declare trigger, source, process_clue, industrial_reason, and asset_family_reason. Enforced by motor_062 (Layer F). Default mode is 'warn' until upstream generators populate the fields; switch __pipeline__.scenario_justification_mode='block' to enforce.
applies_to: scenario_space[].plausibility_status in {plausible*, currently dominant*, not ruled out*, possible*}
message: Active scenario is missing one or more required justification fields.
tests: active scenarios without all 5 fields must produce a warning
falsified/reduced scenarios must be excluded from audit
